### Bible Pathway - Apr. 27, 2010
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-apr-27-2010-11629431.html
Passage: 1 Kings 14:22-27
Points:
- Judah abandoned God's law and fell into idolatry, forfeiting divine blessing and protection.
- King Shishak of Egypt raided Jerusalem and stripped the temple and royal palace of Solomon's gold shields.
- Rehoboam replaced the stolen treasures with bronze shields to maintain an illusion of royal grandeur.
- Relying on cheap substitutes and outward religious ceremony cannot mask spiritual unfaithfulness or replace obedience.
